title: EvidenceRecord
description: Independent evidence gathered by the Concordance Agent for a single plot and season: rainfall, index trigger, dry-spell timing, and satellite vegetation anomaly.

crop.description: Crop planted on the plot, e.g. 'maize'.

critical_growth_stage.description: Growth stage most sensitive to water stress for this crop (from the frozen protocol).

season_rain_mm.description: Cumulative season rainfall at the plot (mm).

trigger_rain_mm.description: Rainfall threshold below which the index pays (mm), from the frozen protocol.

trigger_percentile.description: Percentile of long-term history used as the trigger, e.g. 30.

index_pays.description: True if season_rain_mm < trigger_rain_mm (index triggers a payout).

low_local_rain.description: True if plot-level rain is below median but above the trigger (supports spatial gap).

max_dry_spell_days.description: Longest consecutive dry-spell (days with < 1 mm rain) during the season.

dry_spell_window_start.description: Start date of the longest dry spell (ISO-8601 date).

dry_spell_window_end.description: End date of the longest dry spell (ISO-8601 date).

dry_spell_overlaps_critical_stage.description: True if the dry spell overlaps the crop's critical growth stage window.

ndvi_observed.description: Observed NDVI value for the plot's pixel during the target period.

ndvi_baseline_mean.description: Long-term NDVI mean for the same pixel and period.

ndvi_anomaly_z.description: NDVI anomaly z-score: (observed - mean) / std. Negative = stress.

ndvi_stress_cutoff_z.description: Z-score threshold below which satellite_stress = true (from frozen protocol).

evidence_source.description: Where the evidence data was sourced from.

evidence_timestamp_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the evidence was retrieved.
